segments.name: Backblaze Storage Cloud
segments.description: Provides cloud storage and backup services on its Backblaze Storage Cloud platform to individuals, developers, large enterprises and neocloud platforms.
segments.evidence: The Company has a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for cloud storage used on the platform, either pay-as-you-go or through capacity and committed contracts, and by subscription.
revenueModel.evidence: B2 Cloud Storage operates as an IaaS model, enabling customers to scale up and down as needed on a pay-as-you-go basis or to purchase capacity or committed contracts for greater predictability.
